from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class FairValueChangeIncome(BaseModel):
    """One quarterly fair value change income record from a financial report."""
    company: str | None = Field(description="Company name the report belongs to")
    period: str | None = Field(description="Time period (e.g., 2021 Q1, 2022 Q1)")
    fair_value_change_income: float | None = Field(description="Fair value change income amount for the period")
    unit: str | None = Field(description="Currency unit, e.g., '元', 'CNY'")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    fair_value_change_income_records: list[FairValueChangeIncome]
